jobs.jobDescription:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

Location: Spain - 100% Home office friendly.

What are we looking for:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync.

What would you do at Fever?

In your first month at Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning, grooming, and retrospectives of the team, and you will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever’s tech stack: frameworks used to develop our applications, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure that support our operations.
  • You will have lots of Pull Requests merged and running in production.
  • You will attend some of the Fever Originals’ experiences, like Candlelight.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will be able to come up with solutions to new difficult problems, defining the solution from the architecture design to its implementation.
  • You will continue creating production-grade Python code designed to handle high levels of traffic, measuring the outcome of the functionalities and improving the product.
  • You will participate in some of the hackdays or hackathons we organise with other teams, and you will mostly know everybody from engineering.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • You will have responsibilities over different parts of the systems, analysing the usage from the users and evolving the platform to meet the users’ needs.
  • You will have participated in the launch of one of our new microservices, from 0 to production.
  • You will mentor other team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
  • You will participate in some of the team-building we organise for your team or the whole engineering team.

About you

Must have skills:

  • Strong knowledge of good practices, testing, and design patterns.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Handling services with high concurrency and high-volume requests.
  • You know how to deliver code from development to production.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • You are proficient in business English

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

  • Django/Flask
  • PostgreSQL and Redis
  • AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

  • 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday
  • Private medical insurance sponsored by the company
  • 40% discount on Fever Marketplace
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • English & Spanish conversational classes
  • Wellhub (former Gympass) membership
  • Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee
  • Budget for engineering events and trainings
  • Young and international environment
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:

  • Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.
  • Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever.
  • Manager Interview - 1.5h: A conversation about how you communicate context and trade-offs, own outcomes, quantify impact, and think about reliability, scale, and system design decisions.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

The GRC Engineer will play a key role in running and scaling Fever's security compliance programme. You will turn compliance from manual, point-in-time exercises into automated, continuously monitored controls, while running several audits in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS and others) and keeping them on time.

This role is "engineer-first" and also delivery-focused. You will work with engineering, security, privacy, finance and business teams to translate requirements into technical controls, build automated evidence collection, assess our vendors, answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs, and manage the compliance projects from start to finish across the Fever group companies.

Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. This is an opportunity to have a real impact as a high-growth global category leader.

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, audit calendar and compliance roadmap.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will support SOC 2 initiatives: scope, control set, gap remediation and readiness for the observation period.
  • You will build automated evidence collection workflows using our compliance platform, AI and scripting.
  • You will run audit requests and auditor follow-ups for the ongoing certifications.
  • You will run vendor security assessments and answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will lead the SOC 2 audit with the external auditor, coordinating control owners across the company.
  • You will manage several compliance projects in parallel, with clear milestones, owners and reporting to leadership.
  • You will create a knowledge base and answer library that speeds up questionnaires, RFPs and partner reviews.
  • You will embed compliance checks and telemetry into a standardised GRC platform for continuous control monitoring.

Key responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Type II readiness, observation period and audit, and keep the controls operating effectively afterwards.
  • Participate in multiple audits and certifications in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS), coordinating evidence, auditors and control owners.
  • Translate requirements into technical controls and build automated evidence collection and continuous control monitoring.
  • Run the third-party risk management process: vendor security assessments, due diligence, risk ratings and follow-up.
  • Manage responses to customer and partner security questionnaires, RFPs and security assessments.
  • Plan and execute compliance projects end to end, reporting status and risks to leadership.
  • Automate compliance checks on AI governance and enablement.
  • Improve key information security processes, including risk management, policies and security awareness.

About you

Must have:

  • Hands-on experience preparing for and running SOC 2 Type II audits, from scoping to final report.
  • Experience managing international audits and certifications (ISO 27001, PCI DSS or similar).
  • Proven experience in vendor security assessments and answering security questionnaires and RFPs.
  • Programming/scripting/AI skills (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) and experience building API integrations to automate evidence gathering.
  • Strong project management skills: planning, prioritisation and stakeholder follow-up across teams.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in GRC Engineering, Security Compliance or Security Engineering in a cloud-native company.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).
  • Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, AWS security or equivalent.
  • Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.
  • Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g. Vanta, Drata) and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive compliance tasks.
  • Experience with AI risk governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).

Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
  • English and Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

jobs.jobDescription:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Note: this role is based remotely out of Europe.

Regional Expectations

  • Based in Europe with strong overlap to customer business hours in the region.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

  • Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.

  • Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.

  • Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.

  • Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.

  • Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.

  • Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.

  • Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.

  • Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.

  • Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.

  • Familiarity with billing or metering systems.

  • SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.

  • Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to contact@example.org.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

This role will be focused on understanding and reducing the security risk of Fever's cloud infrastructure and data. You will run technical risk assessments of our AWS environments, data platforms and new architectures, identify the weaknesses that could lead to a security incident or a data breach, and work with the owning teams until those risks are fixed.

As part of the Cybersecurity team, you will focus on defensive security in cloud and data environments: where our sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, how it is protected, and how secure the infrastructure underneath is. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact in a high-growth global category leader, working alongside experts to implement best practices and innovative security solutions. If you're passionate about cloud and data security and enjoy tackling challenges in a dynamic environment, we’d love to have you on board!

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, data platforms, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, risk methodology and overall security landscape.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will run infrastructure and architecture risk assessments using our risk methodology.
  • You will map where sensitive data is stored and processed (S3, databases, data warehouse, SaaS) and who can access it.
  • You will participate in security configuration reviews to ensure cloud and data environments meet industry standards.
  • You will develop automation to detect data exposure, excessive permissions and misconfigurations.
  • You will participate in vulnerability management sessions, collaborating with stakeholders to drive continuous security improvements.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will own the risk assessment process for infrastructure and data, from design reviews to risk acceptance.
  • You will drive the remediation of the main data and infrastructure risks with clear owners and deadlines.
  • You will lead initiatives to implement secure solutions for data: classification, encryption and key management, and least-privilege access.
  • You will act as a point of contact for technical guidance on cloud architecture, data security and configurations.
  • You will develop cybersecurity technical documentation and secure best practices guidelines to educate and support stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform technical risk assessments and threat models of cloud infrastructure, data platforms and new architectures, and document residual risk.
  • Maintain the infrastructure and data risk register, prioritising risks and tracking treatment plans with owners.
  • Identify, classify and protect sensitive data across AWS services, data warehouses and SaaS (data security posture).
  • Review and enforce encryption, key management (KMS), network isolation and identity and access controls for data stores.
  • Conduct regular security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in the AWS ecosystem.
  • Develop and deploy automated security solutions to detect, report and remediate data exposure and misconfigurations.
  • Collaborate with Data, DevOps and engineering teams to build security into data pipelines and infrastructure.

About you

Must have:

  • Proven experience performing security risk assessments of cloud infrastructure and architectures (threat modeling, likelihood/impact, residual risk).
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure security including IAM, networking, KMS, S3, logging and organisation-level controls.
  • Good understanding of data security: data classification, encryption, access governance and data loss prevention.
  • Experience securing data platforms (e.g. data lakes, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks or similar) and their pipelines.
  • Proficiency in scripting for automation and security operations (Python, Go or similar).
  • Knowledge of risk and cloud security frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and explain risk to technical and business audiences.
  • 3+ years of experience in cloud security and/or cybersecurity roles.
  • Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).
  • Fluent in English.
  • Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.
  • Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), CNAPP or CSPM tools.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • Knowledge of privacy regulations affecting data (GDPR) and PCI DSS.
  • Security certifications (e.g. CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, CRISC, CISSP or similar).

Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
  • English and Spanish Lessons
  • Gympass Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

About Chili Piper

Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.

We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!

***Currently hiring for this role within the EMEA region***

The Customer Success Manager will be joining our industry-leading Customer Success team responsible for delivering massive value to our customers, improving retention and product adoption. You will own a portfolio of 80-100 customers who have substantial room to grow in their adoption of Chili Piper.

On a day to day basis, you will be working with customers to onboard them quickly, prove ROI and remove any roadblocks along the way. You will be considered an expert in Chili Piper products, Revenue, Sales, Marketing and CS operations and will take pleasure in coaching your customers to success. This is a highly technical role and an understanding of Javascript, HTML, CSS is required.

Responsibilities

  • Own customer onboarding, ensuring fast time to value

  • Train customers and help them implement new use cases

  • Hold the customer and Chili Piper teams accountable to meeting defined success criteria

  • Engage across the Customers organization and work cross-functionally within Chili Piper to identify opportunities and risks, and present recommendations & solutions

  • Proactively solve and act as a point of escalation for technical issues

  • Ensure internal visibility by providing regular updates, status and next steps on a regular cadence through Slack and Email, and via weekly 1:1s with your Manager

  • Produce internal best practices and customer user stories to make customers lives easier

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support the success of your customers, including Sales, Customer Marketing, and other Post-Sales functions

  • Build customer advocates by developing customer case studies and references to support the growth of Chili Piper

  • Identify upsell and cross sell opportunities which are shared with the Account Management team who will then drive commercial negotiations

What We're Looking For

  • Motivated, Solutions Driven and Conscientious person who enjoys a fast paced startup environment

  • Technical experience is required, e.g., implementing Salesforce or Marketing Automation systems, handling technical support cases

  • Basic understanding of Javascript, HTML, CSS

  • Strong proficiency and experience using Salesforce 1-2+ Years Minimum - SFDC Certifications are a strong plus.

  • Strong proficiency and experience using Marketing Automation software 1-2+ Years Minimum (Marketo, Pardot, Hubspot, etc.....) - Marketing Automation Certifications are a strong plus.

  • SFDC implementation, data model (standard and custom objects), REST API, Administrator, Managed Package

  • Experience working with cross functional teams within a customer organization to support a joint outcome

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively via oral & written formats

  • Passion for customer success & excellence

Additional Information

Why you'll love being a part of our team:

Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future.

  • Work with an immensely talented global team

  • Work in a business that’s run fairly and transparently

  • Competitive pay based on market rate wherever you live

  • We lead by example--showing industry peers and leaders how to innovate, improve, and grow--while having fun

How we work:

  • Freedom and flexibility. We’re a 100% distributed team working from around the world, and we've been fully remote since 2016. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom.

  • Solve interesting problems. The software landscape has exploded. There are dozens of solutions for each problem. We want to be different. We come up with new angles on existing problems or invent better solutions to help companies with their sales and marketing. Then we turn these ideas into beautiful, smart software.

  • Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.

  • Be helpful. Our first value as a company is help. Help our customers be successful. Help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our products. Help our team members reach their full potential.

The perks:

  • Unlimited vacation (and we do mean it, and we do take it!)

  • Generous health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Any equipment/software/tech that you need to do your job

  • Annual professional development stipend of $2,000 USD

  • Equity - all Pipers receive stock options

  • Annual company retreat in epic locations (past trips: Paris, Morocco, Tulum, Iceland, Ibiza, India). Check out the video from last year’s retreat in Tenerife.
